{
    public class MigrateOperationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_CalledWithCorrectArguments()

            var migrateOperation = new MigrateOperation(new MigrateSession(), new Sketch());

                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
